about.title: About BrandMyProfile - Human Career Support for GCC & India

descriptions.qatar: BrandMyProfile provides online CV writing, ATS optimization, GCC CV formatting, LinkedIn and career-support services for professionals targeting Qatar's energy, construction and hospitality sectors.
descriptions.india: BrandMyProfile provides online CV writing, ATS CV, GCC CV, Europass CV, LinkedIn and career-support services for Indian professionals preparing for GCC and international opportunities.
